style: Palette of toxic green, hazard yellow, lunar dust grey and deep black, with wild neon magenta, cyan and lime for the anomalous materials. No text, letters, logos, signs or interface anywhere.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1, 4 and 5 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record (they were made on another, illustrated preset). Image 2 is new: the old one had a legible pseudo-logo ('Corgeiiz') and a warning sign on the wall. Image 3 is new: the old one showed a whole 3D town consumed, while the design's second stage is one side-view pixel scene of dirt, bedrock and a single building. Both gameplay images use Pixel Side View, as the game is a side-view 2D game. gen unhinged_lander_heist_scifi --only 2,3, then finish unhinged_lander_heist_scifi --only 2,3.

images.prompt: Wide establishing shot, low angle, through haze: a weathered space lander with glowing thrusters approaches a lunar research facility built into crater walls, industrial blocks with turrets and glowing containment chambers, security spotlights sweeping concrete bunkers.

Side view inside a lunar bunker maze: grey concrete tunnels and a tall vertical shaft, metal pipes along the walls, green emergency lights. A small armored figure in a bulky grey space-infantry battlesuit with a green-visored helmet and a jetpack flies across the tunnel on a short jet of flame, a glowing green canister clamped under one arm, firing a stubby shotgun at a tall thin humanoid guard robot with a rifle on a ledge. Behind the flying figure, an artillery shell bursts in an orange explosion on the spot where it just was. Floating moon dust.

Side view of a small flat pixel diorama scene like a falling sand game: a layer of muted brown dirt across the bottom third, a jagged strip of dark grey bedrock along the very bottom, and a grey concrete building block with rows of light blue windows standing on the dirt, under an orange and violet dusk sky gradient. Three bursts of wildly growing pixel patterns erupt from small canisters around the building: a bright magenta growth spreading like coral, an acid green crystal lattice, and a swirling cyan storm of tiny squares. They eat into the building and the dirt, and where two of them meet the border flashes in a third bright colour, with loose pixels flying up and out of the top of the scene.

Dynamic close portrait, slight low angle: a reckless operative in battle-scarred armor holds up glowing canisters, green-tinted tactical goggles, chaotic green energy patterns swirling behind, scattered debris, improvised modifications on the gear.

Sweeping orbital view of the lunar surface: facilities scattered across crater floors, linked by transport tubes and pipelines, a sprawling central complex, smaller outposts around it, a satellite overhead and Earth hanging in the star-filled sky.
